(i) The one-loop Weinberg operator can arise in three different categories: (1) irreducible diagrams that give the leading contribution to the neutrino mass, (2) one-loop extensions of the usual tree level seesaw mechanisms, and (3) the divergent loop realization of the tree level seesaws.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the leading contribution to the neutrino mass comes from a tree level diagram.
a genuine one-loop contribution to neutrino masses can only be achieved if the neutrino is a Majorana fermion and an additional $ {Z_2} $ symmetry is imposed.
a genuine one-loop contribution to neutrino masses can only be obtained in the type-II loop extension.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in all cases the leading one-loop contribution can be avoided, if the tree level contribution is not suppressed by a small parameter.
the leading one-loop neutrino masses are either generated from the irreducible diagrams or the loop extensions of the seesaws.

in the case of a one-loop realization of the seesaw mechanism, a tree level contribution to the neutrino mass must be present and a Majorana fermion is needed in the loop to avoid a vanishing contribution to the neutrinos mass.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the d = 4 and d = 5 operators are not independent and the d = 6 operator cannot be ignored in any consistent theory of neutrino mass.
all one-loop neutrino masses can be classified into one of these three categories, which are characterized by their divergent behavior.
the one-loop level of neutrino mass models can be understood in a unified way.
